column1: # model-pricing.tsv — single source of truth for LLM token prices (USD per 1M tokens).
# Every price change is a reviewed PR — prices are DATA, not code.
#   1 model_glob      shell glob matched against the record's model string ('*' wildcard)
#   2 effective_from  ISO date (UTC) this rate took effect; rows are date-versioned
#   3 input           USD / MTok for base (uncached) input tokens
#   4 cache_read      USD / MTok for cache-read (hit) tokens
#   5 cache_write     USD / MTok for cache-creation (write) tokens
#   6 output          USD / MTok for output tokens
# SELECTION (deterministic): for a record with model M and timestamp T, pick the row
# whose glob matches M AND whose effective_from <= T, choosing the MOST SPECIFIC glob
# (most literal characters); ties break to the LATEST effective_from. So a call is
# always priced at the rate in effect on the day it ran.
# PRICE CHANGES: never edit an existing row — APPEND a new row for the same glob with a
# later effective_from. Old records keep their historical rate; new ones pick up the new
# cache_write is Anthropic's 5-minute cache-write rate (1.25x base input). Batch (-50%),
# fast-mode, data-residency (1.1x) and server-tool surcharges are NOT modelled.
# (2026-06-06). Non-Claude rows are best-effort — verify before trusting (marked VERIFY).
